description: Durable workflows for agents (Cloudflare Workflows): up to 25 steps of HTTP calls (automatic retries), sleeps of up to 30 days, and human approval gates, with a callback when done. Survives restarts; pass the previous response into the next step with {{prev}}. $0.005 + $0.001 per step; status/approve/reject $0.002. Costs $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

steps.description: [{type: http, url, method, body} | {type: sleep, seconds} | {type: approval, timeout_hours, notify_url}]
